ALTER VIEW [DW].[FactDepositsOutstandingBalance_1Year_View]
	AS 

WITH FactDep_Latest AS (
SELECT AccountSK
,max(FDL.BusinessDateSK) AS LatestBusinessDateSK
,max(FDL.BusinessDateSK) - 10000 AS EarliestBusinessDateSK
FROM DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance as FDL
GROUP BY ACCOUNTSK
)

Select DEP.*
from DW.FactDepositsOutstandingBalance as DEP
    INNER JOIN FactDep_Latest as FDL
        ON FDL.AccountSK = DEP.AccountSK
    WHERE Dep.BusinessdateSK BETWEEN FDL.EarliestBusinessDateSK AND FDL.LatestBusinessDateSK
